content: असंबाध {%a.%} .²1 Not narrow, spacious, wide; असंबाधं बध्यतो मानवानाम् <ls>Av. 12. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 Not crowded with people, lonely, solitary; वसन्नसंबाधशिवेऽपि देशे <ls>Ki. 3. 53</ls>. .²3 Open, accessible. .²4 Separated by an interval; द्विपैरसंबाधमयांबभूवे <ls>Śi. 3. 67</ls>. .²5 Without pain. .{@-धा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a metre consisting of 56 syllables. .{@-धम्@} <ab>Ved.</ab> Open space; असंबाधे पृथिव्या उरौ लोके नि धीयस्व <ls>Av. 18. 2. 20</ls>.
